name: Hamden Hall Summer Programs
description_short: Summer day programs at a Hamden, CT private school. They include sports camps for rising grades 2-10, an Early Childhood Discovery Program for preschool through kindergarten, an Intersession Adventure Program, and Academics & Adventures, a full-day program with a morning class and afternoon activities such as swimming, field trips and crafts.
activities: academic morning courses (science, math, creative writing, art)
special_needs_notes: The facility is nut-free. Children with special health care needs or disabilities must have an Individual Plan of Care on file, written by the child's healthcare provider and parents. Early Childhood participants must be potty-trained. Medication is held by the nurse.
swim_waterfront_notes: Swimming is in the school's heated indoor pool at the Beckerman Athletic Center. Campers bring a bathing suit and towel each day.

sources.note: Drafted by the listing tool from this page

warnings: The page shows the 2026 season ('Week by Week Program Offerings 2026'), which has already ended. No 2027 information is published yet.
Weeks are listed with no year. They were recorded as 2026 because the page references 2026 and the weekdays match (June 29, 2026 is a Monday).
The page covers several separate programs. Session dates and the $400 weekly price apply only to Academics & Adventures.
Sports Camps run at the Skiff Street Athletic Complex, not the 1108 Whitney Avenue main address. Hours vary by program: Sports 9-3, Early Childhood 8-4, Academics & Adventures 9-4.

Contacts differ by program: Sports Camp Director Joe Fontana (jfontana@hamdenhall.org, 203-752-2642) and Summer Academy Director Angelica Demers (ademers@hamdenhall.org). The phone number recorded is the school's main line.
Before care is listed as 8:00-8:30am while the program starts at 9:00am, so there may be a gap or a typo.
